src = open('solver.py').read()
addition = '''
    def sp_dag_push(self, s, t, pi, dist, limit):
        """Push a max flow of up to ``limit`` units through the shortest-path
        DAG (edges tight w.r.t. ``dist``).  Every s-t path in this DAG has the
        same reduced cost, so a batched push preserves reduced-cost optimality
        once potentials are updated by ``dist``.  Returns the pushed amount."""
        n = self.n
        tight_u = []
        tight_v = []
        tight_e = []
        heads = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u in range(n):
            du = dist[u]
            if du is None:
                continue
            base = du + pi[u]
            for ei in self.adj[u]:
                if self.cap[ei] <= 0:
                    continue
                v = self.to[ei]
                dv = dist[v]
                if dv is None:
                    continue
                if base + self.cost[ei] - pi[v] == dv:
                    heads[u].append(len(tight_e))
                    tight_u.append(u)
                    tight_v.append(v)
                    tight_e.append(ei)
        m = len(tight_e)
        if m == 0:
            return 0
        # Dinic on the tight subgraph
        radj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(m):
            radj[tight_u[i]].append(i)
        rcap = [self.cap[tight_e[i]] for i in range(m)]
        match = [-1] * m
        for i in range(m):
            u, v, ei = tight_u[i], tight_v[i], tight_e[i]
            for k in radj[v]:
                if tight_u[k] == u and tight_e[k] == self.rev[ei] and match[i] < 0:
                    match[i] = k
                    match[k] = i
        total = 0
        while total < limit:
            level = [-1] * n
            level[s] = 0
            q = deque([s])
            while q:
                u = q.popleft()
                lu = level[u]
                for i in radj[u]:
                    if rcap[i] > 0:
                        v = tight_v[i]
                        if level[v] < 0:
                            level[v] = lu + 1
                            q.append(v)
            if level[t] < 0:
                break
            it = [0] * n

            def dfs(u, f):
                if u == t:
                    return f
                r = radj[u]
                while it[u] < len(r):
                    i = r[it[u]]
                    v = tight_v[i]
                    if rcap[i] > 0 and level[v] == level[u] + 1:
                        d = dfs(v, f if f < rcap[i] else rcap[i])
                        if d > 0:
                            rcap[i] -= d
                            j = match[i]
                            if j >= 0:
                                rcap[j] += d
                            return d
                    it[u] += 1
                return 0

            while total < limit:
                f = dfs(s, limit - total)
                if f == 0:
                    break
                total += f
        # apply pushes to the real residual
        for i in range(m):
            pushed = self.cap[tight_e[i]] - rcap[i]
            if pushed > 0:
                ei = tight_e[i]
                self.cap[ei] -= pushed
                self.cap[self.rev[ei]] += pushed
        return total
'''
